svg.title: Octopus chef at a ramen booth
svg.desc: An octopus in a white toque and chef's coat works a nighttime ramen yatai. Eight tentacles stir a stockpot, ladle broth, lift noodles, lay nori, set an egg, scatter scallions, hold a towel, and cradle a finished bowl. Noren curtains read ラーメン, and a wooden sign reads 営業中.
